title: Easy to put together. Uncomfortable to sit in.
text:
Easy to put together. Uncomfortable to sit in.. I got an identical chair a year ago from a different brand and this one gives me a matching pair for the dogs. These chairs look nice and the fabric is true grey linen texture. Putting it together is a simple matter of just attaching the four legs.

However, both are uncomfortable to sit in for more than a few minutes. The seat cushion is hard and there's no lumbar support at all. I would never expect guests to actually use these. My dogs flat out love the chairs. They curl up against the rounded back and have support on three sides - like a raised bolster bed. It let's the dogs have furniture of their own and leaves my good chairs and sofa free for people.
